decisions.reason: This air fin cooler remains close to the core portfolio and aligned with the firm's efficiency-focused heat-exchange strategy, although last year's portfolio pruning suggests a modestly higher withdrawal risk than before.

The condenser fits the established engineering and service base, but overlap with nearby offerings and the firm's demonstrated willingness to reallocate resources raise the chance of consolidation somewhat.
As another core-near condenser it is still more likely to be retained than withdrawn, yet similarity to other condenser products makes it the most exposed to portfolio rationalization.
The tube liner supports the installed-base repair and upgrade business, which is strategically valuable and typically sticky for an industrial machinery firm with strong lifecycle services.
These repair inserts reinforce the aftermarket service business and customer retention, so they are likely to stay despite a small general risk of pruning after last year's withdrawal of Product E.
